policies.name: No opaque continuous rotations
policies.description: Flags bare/opaque 'u' and 'u3' gates. Continuous parameter gates resist review and can hide arbitrary single-qubit behavior; require explicit rx/ry/rz decomposition. Heuristic hygiene rule, not a threat detector.

policies.name: Measurement fan-out ceiling 16
policies.description: Flags circuits reporting to more than 16 classical bits. Unusually wide measurement surfaces are a staging shape for result scraping. Heuristic hygiene rule, not a threat detector; OpenQASM measurements are position-less in the IR, so ordering is not asserted.

policies.name: Depth ceiling 64
policies.description: Circuits deeper than 64 layers deserve manual review: disproportionate depth is the signature of camouflaged dead-code insertion. Heuristic hygiene rule, not a threat detector.

policies.name: Two-qubit density ceiling 75%
policies.description: Two-qubit gates above 75% of the pool suggest gate-soup optimisation or dilution. Heuristic hygiene rule, not a threat detector.

policies.name: Width ceiling 24 qubits
policies.description: Circuits wider than 24 qubits are outside the reviewed small-system envelope. Heuristic hygiene rule, not a threat detector.

policies.name: No ccx (Toffoli) gates
policies.description: Toffoli gates concentrate multi-qubit control structure; in reviewed pipelines they should be decomposed and tracked explicitly. Heuristic hygiene rule, not a threat detector.
